# ⚡ Eisen Engine [![Build](https://github.com/shubhanshushrimali/Eisen-Engine/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/shubhanshushrimali/Eisen-Engine/actions/workflows/build.yml) [![Release](https://github.com/shubhanshushrimali/Eisen-Engine/actions/workflows/release.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/shubhanshushrimali/Eisen-Engine/actions/workflows/release.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![C++20](https://img.shields.io/badge/C++-20-blue.svg?logo=cplusplus)](https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/20) [![OpenGL 4.6](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenGL-4.6-green.svg)](https://www.opengl.org/) ![Platforms](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platforms-Win%20|%20Linux%20|%20macOS%20|%20iOS%20|%20Android%20|%20WebGL-brightgreen) ![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/shubhanshushrimali/Eisen-Engine?style=social) **Eisen Engine** is an AI-native, cross-platform C++20 game engine built for the next generation of game development. Featuring a Frostbite-style Render Graph, EnTT ECS, Jolt/Box2D physics, multi-agent AI orchestration via LangGraph + MCP, and builds targeting **9 platforms** from a single codebase. --- ## ✨ Feature Matrix | Category | Feature | Technology | Status | |:---------|:--------|:-----------|:------:| | 🎨 **Rendering** | OpenGL 4.6 Core Profile | DSA, VAO, Shaders | ✅ | | 🎨 | Render Graph (Frame Graph) | DAG with pass culling | ✅ | | 🎨 | Shader Hot-Reload | GLSL, `#type` directives | ✅ | | 🎨 | Texture System | stb_image, sampler objects | ✅ | | 🧮 **ECS** | Entity Component System | EnTT (sparse-set) | ✅ | | 🧮 | 25+ Component Types | Transform, Camera, Lights, etc. | ✅ | | 🧮 | Scene Serialization | JSON import/export | ✅ | | ⚡ **Physics** | 3D Rigid Bodies & Raycasting | Jolt Physics | ✅ | | ⚡ | 2D Physics & Contacts | Box2D v3 (multi-threaded) | ✅ | | 🔊 **Audio** | 3D Spatial Audio | miniaudio (WAV/MP3/FLAC) | ✅ | | 🌐 **Networking** | Reliable/Unreliable UDP | ENet | ✅ | | 🤖 **AI** | Behavior Trees | Selector/Sequence/Parallel | ✅ | | 🤖 | Multi-Agent Orchestration | LangGraph (8 agents) | ✅ | | 🤖 | 30+ Engine MCP Tools | Model Context Protocol | ✅ | | 🤖 | Skill-Based Routing | Capability matching + LLM | ✅ | | 🤖 | Durable State Checkpoints | SQLite persistence | ✅ | | 🖥️ **Editor** | Docking Editor | Dear ImGui | ✅ | | 🖥️ | 3D Viewport Gizmos | ImGuizmo | ✅ | | 🖥️ | Performance Telemetry | ImPlot | ✅ | | 🖥️ | Visual Node Graphs | imnodes | ✅ | | 📦 **Assets** | glTF 2.0 Model Loading | fastgltf (SIMD) | ✅ | | 📦 | Mesh Optimization & LOD | meshoptimizer | ✅ | | 🧵 **Threading** | Job System | Lock-free work stealing | ✅ | | 🔍 **Profiling** | CPU/GPU Instrumentation | Tracy Profiler | ✅ | | 📁 **Core** | Virtual File System | Mount points + hot-reload | ✅ | | 📁 | Action-Based Input | Rebinding + gamepads | ✅ | | 📁 | UUID System | 64-bit entity/asset IDs | ✅ | ## 🌍 Platform Support | Platform | Graphics | Build Tool | Status | |:---------|:---------|:-----------|:------:| | Windows x64 | OpenGL 4.6 | MSVC / CMake | ✅ | | Windows Server (Headless) | None | MSVC / CMake | ✅ | | Linux x64 | OpenGL 4.6 | GCC / CMake | ✅ | | Linux Server (Headless) | None | GCC / CMake | ✅ | | macOS (ARM64) | OpenGL / Metal | Xcode / CMake | ✅ | | macOS Server (Headless) | None | Clang / CMake | ✅ | | iOS (ARM64) | Metal | Xcode / CMake | ✅ | | Android (ARM64) | OpenGL ES 3.2 | NDK / CMake | ✅ | | WebGL / WebAssembly | WebGL 2.0 | Emscripten | ✅ | ## 🚀 Quick Start ### Prerequisites - **C++20 compiler** (MSVC 2022+, GCC 13+, Clang 16+) - **CMake 3.25+** - **Git** with submodule support ### Build (Any Platform) ```bash # Clone with submodules git clone --recursive https://github.com/shubhanshushrimali/Eisen-Engine.git cd Eisen-Engine # Windows (Visual Studio) cmake -B build -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A x64 cmake --build build --config Release # Linux / macOS cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release cmake --build build -j$(nproc) # Headless Server (any OS) cmake -B build -DEISEN_SERVER_ONLY=ON -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release cmake --build build # WebGL (Emscripten) emcmake cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release cmake --build build # Android (NDK) cmake -B build \ -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=$NDK/build/cmake/android.toolchain.cmake \ -DANDROID_ABI=arm64-v8a -DANDROID_PLATFORM=android-26 cmake --build build # iOS (Xcode) cmake -B build -G Xcode -DCMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME=iOS ``` ### Windows (Legacy Premake) ```bash vendor/bin/premake/premake5.exe vs2022 # Open Eisen.sln → Build → Run ``` ## 🏗️ Architecture ``` Eisen-Engine/ ├── CMakeLists.txt # Cross-platform CMake build ├── premake5.lua # Legacy Windows build ├── Dockerfile # Headless server container ├── docker-compose.yml # Server + AI orchestrator ├── .github/ │ ├── workflows/ │ │ ├── build.yml # 9-target CI/CD matrix │ │ └── release.yml # Auto-release on tags │ └── ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ # Bug reports & feature requests ├── cmake/platforms/ # Toolchain files │ ├── Emscripten.cmake # WebGL/WebAssembly │ ├── Android.cmake # NDK ARM64 │ ├── iOS.cmake # Metal ARM64 │ └── LinuxHeadless.cmake # No-GPU server ├── Eisen/ # ENGINE (Static Library) │ ├── CMakeLists.txt │ ├── Src/ │ │ ├── Eisen/ │ │ │ ├── AI/ # Behavior trees │ │ │ ├── Audio/ # miniaudio 3D spatial │ │ │ ├── Core/ # UUID, Input, VFS │ │ │ ├── Debug/ # Tracy profiler │ │ │ ├── Events/ # Event system │ │ │ ├── ImGui/ # Editor integration │ │ │ ├── Math/ # GLM wrappers │ │ │ ├── Networking/ # ENet UDP │ │ │ ├── Physics/ # Jolt 3D + Box2D 2D │ │ │ ├── Renderer/ │ │ │ │ ├── RenderGraph/ # Frostbite-style Frame Graph │ │ │ │ ├── Buffer, Shader, Texture... │ │ │ ├── Scene/ # EnTT ECS + Serialization │ │ │ └── Threading/ # Job system │ │ └── Platform/ │ │ ├── PAL.h # Platform Abstraction Layer │ │ ├── OpenGL/ # OpenGL 4.6 backend │ │ ├── Windows/ # Win32 + WGL │ │ ├── Linux/ # X11 + EGL │ │ ├── macOS/ # Cocoa + Metal │ │ ├── iOS/ # UIKit + Metal │ │ ├── Android/ # JNI + EGL │ │ ├── Web/ # Emscripten + WebGL │ │ └── Headless/ # Null renderer │ └── Vendor/ # 17 libraries (git submodules) ├── Sandbox/ # EDITOR APPLICATION └── tools/ ├── ai/ # AI ORCHESTRATION │ ├── eisen_graph.py # LangGraph 8-node agent graph │ ├── skills/routing.py # Capability-based skill router │ └── state/ # SQLite checkpoints + scene snapshots └── mcp/ # MCP SERVER (30+ tools) ``` ## 🤖 AI-Native Development ### Multi-Agent Orchestration ``` User Prompt → Router → [Level Designer | Shader FX | Gameplay | QA | Network | UI] → Validator → Done ``` Each agent has **scoped MCP tool access** — the Level Designer can create/delete entities, but can't touch shaders. The Router uses **capability-based scoring + LLM confidence** to pick the right specialist. ### MCP Server (30+ Tools) ```bash cd tools/mcp pip install -r requirements.txt python eisen_mcp_server.py ``` | Category | Tools | |:---------|:------| | Scene | `create_entity`, `delete_entity`, `list_entities`, `set_transform`, `duplicate_entity` | | Components | `add_component`, `remove_component`, `set_component_property` | | Physics | `set_gravity`, `apply_force`, `raycast`, `set_physics_material` | | Rendering | `hot_reload_shader`, `set_material_property`, `set_render_mode` | | Audio | `play_sound`, `stop_all_sounds`, `set_master_volume` | | Assets | `import_model`, `list_assets` | | Scripting | `execute_lua`, `reload_script` | | Profiling | `get_frame_metrics`, `get_physics_metrics`, `get_memory_usage` | | Build | `compile_project`, `export_scene` | | Project | `read_source_file`, `list_source_files`, `get_engine_status` | ### Docker Deployment ```bash # Start headless server + AI orchestrator docker-compose up -d # Or just the server docker build -t eisen-server . docker run -p 7777:7777/udp -p 8080:8080 eisen-server ``` ## 📝 Shader Format ```glsl #type vertex #version 460 core layout(location = 0) in vec3 a_Position; layout(location = 1) in vec4 a_Color; out vec4 v_Color; void main() { v_Color = a_Color; gl_Position = vec4(a_Position, 1.0); } #type fragment #version 460 core layout(location = 0) out vec4 color; in vec4 v_Color; void main() { color = v_Color; } ``` ## 🛣️ Roadmap - [x] **Phase 1** — Foundation (Window, Events, Layers, PCH) - [x] **Phase 2** — Renderer (OpenGL 4.6, Shaders, Textures, ImGui) - [x] **Phase 3** — ECS (EnTT), Physics (Jolt + Box2D), Audio (miniaudio) - [x] **Phase 4** — AI Agents (LangGraph, MCP 30+ tools) - [x] **Phase 5** — CMake Cross-Platform (9 targets) - [x] **Phase 6** — Render Graph, Behavior Trees - [x] **Phase 7** — AI Skill Routing, Durable Checkpoints - [x] **Phase 8** — GitHub DevOps (CI/CD, Docker, Templates) - [ ] **Phase 9** — WebGPU (Dawn) → Metal + Vulkan + DX12 - [ ] **Phase 10** — Visual Shader Editor + Runtime Scripting ## 🤝 Contributing See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for coding standards, branch strategy, and PR workflow. ## 🔒 Security See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for vulnerability reporting. ## 📄 License MIT License — see [LICENSE](LICENSE) for details. ---
